A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by his [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Dark Holocron)|apprentice]].

==Biography==
An individual began training in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. This Jedi eventually passed the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] and was [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|knighted]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Further pursuits of knowledge of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] skill earned this individual the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]]. It was at this point in life that this individual spotted an [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Dark Holocron)|initiate]] and took him as a Padawan.<ref name="DLotS4" />

The Jedi Master trained his Padawan to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knighthood]], but eventually the Knight tried to learn about the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. He believed that he could learn its secrets while remaining true to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]], yet he fell under the dark side's seductive power. After having an argument with his Master, he gave into his anger and [[Death/Legends|killed]] his master. His story was later featured in a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]].<ref name="DLotS4" />

In [[3997 BBY]],<ref name="3997 BBY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]] to [[3997 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Krath Holy Crusade]], Jedi Knight [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] decided to infiltrate a dark side [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]] known as the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] and dismantle it from within. Jedi Master [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] decided to warn Qel-Droma about the dangers of the dark side by showing him the story of the Dark Jedi in the [[Dark Holocron]]. Stunned by the images he saw, Qel-Droma lashed out at Bnar and Odan-Urr, and proclaimed that they would rather do nothing than try to defeat the dark side.<ref name="DLotS4" />
